title: Astro or Next.js? Make the call
description: Explore framework boundaries, architecture defaults, and five decisions that shape a web application.
outcome: Choose a framework around the experience you need to build.

title: Build an Astro feature boundary
description: Get hands-on with the boundary between a content-driven page and an interactive feature.
outcome: Explore where interactivity belongs in an Astro page.

title: Semantic Routing Lab
description: Choose models for different routes, experiment with requests, and explore how routing decisions affect efficiency in a simulated LangGraph pipeline.
outcome: Trace semantic routing through a StateGraph and compare model choices across PDF, spreadsheet, and unstructured inputs.

title: Orchestrating a D&D Quest with Conductor OSS
description: Explore workflow orchestration through a Dungeons & Dragons quest, with conditional paths, parallel scouting, and a human dungeon master.
outcome: Understand how branching, fork/join, and human approval fit into a durable workflow.

title: Navigating NY-NJ Cross-Border Taxation
description: Explore residency, domicile, telecommuting, and tax credits for clients who live in New Jersey and work in New York. Focused on 2025 tax-return preparation.
outcome: Identify filing obligations and common pitfalls when preparing NY-NJ cross-border returns.

title: Webflow Cloud Audio Field Guide
description: Explore interactive tools, campaign experiences, and customer portals that complement a Webflow-managed site.
outcome: Understand how to leverage Webflow Cloud's capabilities to enhance user experiences.

title: Containers in Practice: A course on Kubernetes for curious developers
description: Containers, without the leap of faith. Listen, explore, then prove it in your terminal.
outcome: Each checkpoint asks you to keep evidence of what happened and explain what it proves.

title: Feature Flags, Experimentation, and the Moment Shipping Got Less Terrifying
description: How modern teams reduce release risk, learn faster, and avoid turning every deploy into a collective stress event.
outcome: Understand that teams want a more opinionated path.
